title: Rupert superballs
plain: The cube can pass through a hole drilled in a copy of itself; the round ball cannot. Show every superball between them, |x|^p+|y|^p+|z|^p ≤ 1 with p > 2, can.
math: Let $B_p=\{|x|^p+|y|^p+|z|^p\le1\}$. Prove that for every $p\in(2,\infty)$ there are orthogonal projections $\pi_1,\pi_2$ onto planes and a rigid motion $\rho$ of the plane with $\rho(\pi_1(B_p))\subset\operatorname{int}\pi_2(B_p)$.
